summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 26–41
summary.text: Chapters 26–41 of an astrological treatise discuss planetary powers in pits, nativities involving Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, the Sun, and Mercury, sea voyages, adversaries and war, the lot of fortune, religions that founded astronomy, eye injuries, love, transits, prorogation, and releasing prisoners. Authorities quoted include Apomasar and Sadan, with references to Indian astrology and an appendix.
